title: Acute appendicitis in a patient immunised with COVID-19 vaccine: A case report with morphological analysis.
ehr_evidence: Clinical case presentation and hospital records of a single 58-year-old female patient at Careggi University Hospital.
summary: Case report describing acute appendicitis occurring approximately 48 hours after the first dose of the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine in a 58-year-old female, with histological evidence of Th1-driven granulomatous inflammation.
key_findings: A 58-year-old female developed acute appendicitis approximately 48 hours after her first Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine dose.
Histopathology revealed diffuse acute and chronic inflammatory infiltrates with non-necrotizing granulomas.
WHO causality assessment indicated a B1 rating (temporal relation consistent but insufficient definitive evidence).
data_availability_statement: Data are available upon reasonable request to the corresponding author.
